If you choose to add this day, venture to Arenal Volcano. Witness the awe-inspiring views of the active volcano, hike through lush rainforests, and visit hot springs for a relaxing soak.

Day 4: Night Jungle Tour
Experience the night-time jungle in all its glory during a guided tour. Hear the symphony of nocturnal creatures, spot rare insects and amphibians, and learn about the nocturnal habits of wildlife.

Day 5: Relax and Replenish
Take a day to unwind and rejuvenate. Enjoy a spa treatment, relax by the pool, or simply savor the serenity of your eco-lodge.

Day 6: Goodbye Costa Rica
Bid farewell to Costa Rica, taking with you memories of its breathtaking landscapes and diverse wildlife.

This itinerary encompasses the best of Costa Rica's eco-tourism and wildlife, offering a unique and sustainable travel experience.
